title: Oral and gut microbiota after acromegaly treatment: prospective assessment and insights from machine learning.
summary: Prospective pre- and post-treatment microbiota profiles from 19 acromegaly patients were analyzed with machine learning; the results report microbiota patterns and associations by treatment remission group, a limited clinical microbiome result.
